schema_doc: Canonical paragraph-level corrections registry. Source of truth for all manual edits applied on top of the immutable FB2 source. Pipeline: fb2_remake.fb2 → parse → text_corrections.json → apply → remake_data.js / book_text.md.

version_history.v1 → v2: Major reconciliation pass after ChatGPT 5.5 + Gemini 3.1 Pro parallel audits (Apr 2026). Removed 3 spurious pending items (§13 stamina+15, §140 gold+30, §532 wound_2 — first two were misinterpretations of paragraph-arithmetic mechanics, third was already implemented in src/remake_data.js + src/game_logic.js). Corrected §166 canonical branch set. Registered ~25 new pending items across 4 categories: gold-sign data bugs, missing passive auto-effects, missing item acquisitions, conditional-choice gating, and the dynamic-target paragraph-arithmetic engine cluster.
version_history.v2 → v2.1: May 2026 sweep against current MJ_MAP and art_catalog.py state revealed that all Group 4 art-mapping recommendations from both audits were already in place: §1072 already maps to art09_sleeping_princess; art12_camp/art29_hostess/art41_mounted catalogues already match MJ_MAP; §319/§100/§558/§846/§1123 already use the recommended arts. The audits were taken before previous sessions had already cleaned up these mappings. Items recorded in resolved_no_op below as verified-and-resolved so future audits don't resurrect them.

Each is a non-blocker but should not be lost: §874 silver bracelet has no acquisition path; bronze whistle is granted under three different name strings; §1122 partial inventory loss (knives) is narrative-only. Added as pending groups 11, 12, 13.
version_history.v2.2 → v2.3: May 2026 investigation deepened group_11 (silver bracelet). FB2 search confirmed there is no auto-acquisition paragraph for 'Серебряный браслет'. The item is purchased from the peasant's shop in §340 along with 8 other items. §340 in remake_data.js has the FB2 text describing the shop but no purchase mechanism — only 3 navigation choices (leave west / south / stay). This is a symptom of a missing shop/buy-choice engine feature, not a single-paragraph fix. Group 11 reclassified as architectural; new group_14 added to track the shop-mechanic gap across the book.

The post-combat acquisition half of group_12 (7 paragraphs where the player kills a goblin and then takes the whistle from the corpse) cannot be closed without a new engine feature, because auto_items applies on first paragraph entry, before combat resolves. Registered as new group_15.
version_history.v2.4 → v2.5: May 2026 — group_13 reclassified after FB2 verification. The Gemini graph audit had read the §1122 «ножей и след простыл» line as inventory loss of knife-class items, but FB2 review shows the knives were never inventory items at all — they were an attack effect from a previous trap paragraph causing wounds. The §1122 effect is the canonical −5 STAMINA cost the canon states explicitly («вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны»), so this is a Group 1.3-class missing auto-effect, not a Group 7-class inventory loss. Applied auto_items.stamina_sub=5 and moved registry entry from pending_corrections to resolved_no_op with the corrected interpretation. The lose_substring engine extension idea originally floated in group_13 is no longer needed for this paragraph (and there are no other knife-loss paragraphs in the data either).

Preferred fix: one vertical scroll-flow for text+art+choices with fixed HUD; quick fix: dvh cap + overflow-y:auto; shops may deserve a grouped scrollable catalog with an always-visible exit.

JS builds .visual-dock/.visual-pill and toggles body.hide-inline-art, and combat DOM uses .combat-enemy-head/.ce-status-pill/.state-*/.combat-stat-pill/.combat-hp-track/.combat-hp-fill - none of these selectors have CSS in src or dist, so the art toggle cannot hide illustrations and the combat HP bar/status pills render unstyled. Either finish the component CSS to the DOM contract or remove the dead elements; add a selector-presence test.

At <=700px the sidebar becomes a 38vh scroll container competing with the 62vh story scroll while choices sit in a non-scrolling bottom and the floating log FAB can cover the last button. Proposal: compact 56-72px sticky HUD (stats+gold+menu) with spells/bag/notes/map in bottom sheets and the log docked in the HUD.

37 shell buttons carry no role/aria-*; overlays lack dialog semantics, focus trap, Escape and focus return; .btn{outline:none} with no :focus-visible; mini-map is a clickable div and several controls are spans; no live-regions for notifications/combat log; the name label is not bound via for. Proposal: shared dialog controller + real buttons + gold focus ring + aria-live/log + axe-core pass.

--muted (3.85:1) and --red2 (3.48:1) are used on 10-14px text (42 small-size declarations); several touch controls are 32x32 or smaller despite the 44x44 comment. Proposal: raise muted to ~#8a7a9e and red to ~#d6574b, introduce a --tap:44px token, keep interactive text >=16px.

Fixed title screen can overflow on landscape phones (no height/orientation breakpoints); preface/pregame keep inline 40/60px padding on mobile; 100vh instead of dvh; safe-area padding sits on body while screens are position:fixed; no viewport-fit=cover. Proposal: dvh + clamp padding + safe-area on the fixed shell + landscape testing.

Cinzel/Cinzel Decorative ship Latin-only unicode-range with bare serif fallback, so RU/UK headings render in system serif while EN/FR get Cinzel - identity varies by language/OS. Minimum: add Cormorant Garamond (already bundled with Cyrillic) as the explicit ui/title fallback; ideally a licensed Cyrillic display face metrically compatible with Cinzel.

Spell selection shows ten pips but no X/10 text counter (JS looks for a missing #spell-counter-chip); +/- lack accessible names, no real disabled at bounds. Proposal: live 'Selected X of 10', aria-labels, disabled, 44px targets; keep pips decorative.

Map toolbar hardcodes English Reset/Fullscreen (initial fog-of-war line too); +/- have no labels; mini-map is pointer-only; mobile side panel takes up to 30vh before a dense 1600x1000 SVG. Proposal: localize the toolbar, add aria/titles, keyboard mini-map, mobile-first location/percentage summary, persist zoom/layer.

Six keyframes and 18 transitions with no prefers-reduced-motion; almost no :active states for touch; frequent autosave with no saved-state indicator; alert/confirm for import/new game break the theme. Proposal: reduced-motion mode, pressed states, 'Autosaved - secN - time' in the menu, themed dialogs with undo/double-confirm for destructive actions.

Story container allows ~1100px line length on wide screens; choices are permanently separated from the text by a bordered fixed block, weakening the read-then-decide rhythm. Proposal: cap #s-text/#c-list at ~68-74ch centered inside a full-width scroll container; place choices right after the text under a 'Your choice' heading.

The launcher icon's fine detail muddies at 32-64px (keep the illustration for splash; make a simple mark for favicon/launcher); 58 inline style attributes + 18 cssText + ~140 direct style ops hinder unified responsive/a11y patches - gradually extract to classes and tokens (surface/text/accent/danger/tap/focus/motion).

group_14_shop_buy_choice_engine.comment: Several paragraphs across the book describe a shop-style merchant selling multiple items at named prices, but the engine has no purchase choice type. Players read the prices in the text, but the only choices on the screen are navigation. Found via the silver bracelet investigation (group_11) — §340 (peasant) is one such case with 9 items. There are likely others (Vodyanoy's tavern food/water sales in §873 use ad-hoc gold_sub but only on auto_items, not on choice-level purchase). A general shop mechanism would unify these. Architectural design needed before implementation: choice schema extension (new fields on choice: purchase=true, gold_cost=N, grants_items=['...']), engine renderChoices changes (show price in label, gate by S.gold>=cost, deduct gold and add item on click), and per-paragraph data fixes wherever shops occur.

Vodyanoy's tavern. Items: жареная рыба 1g (→§922), родниковая вода 2g (→§767). Has navigation choices but no item grant on those purchases. Less critical because the only food benefit is narrative — but adds inconsistency.

design_options: Option A: new auto_items_after_combat field. Engine applies it when sec.enemies && combatDone[S.section] becomes true, rather than on firstVisit. Symmetric with existing auto_items.

Option B: new acquires field on choice. choice = {target, label, acquires: ['Бронзовый свисток']}. Engine deposits items at the moment the player clicks the choice. More flexible — different post-combat choices could grant different items (e.g. 'take whistle' vs 'leave whistle').
Option C: paragraph splitting — introduce a synthetic intermediate paragraph between combat and the next location, and put auto_items on it. Heavy data refactor; not recommended.

Letter-ordinal-sum riddle mechanic. Player types Russian answer; engine computes letter-sum and adds canonical modifier to navigate to success paragraph. Two canonical riddles wired:

  - sec.992 spider column riddle (+825 → sec.932 success / sec.1123 exit)

Riddle 2 answer "смерть" (sum 107) verified: sec.932 narrative opens "Верно, ты угадал, смерть деньгами не подкупишь, — говорит паук". ChatGPT design proposal speculated "год" → §850, but Claude verification showed §850 is throne-tray narrative, not a riddle success. Correct answer rederived from canonical spider gift narrative at §932.
group_18_letter_sum_riddle.engine_changes:
Three new functions in src/game_logic.js:
  - applyRiddleAnswer(input, riddleConfig): normalise input (uppercase, strip non-Cyrillic), optional ё→е equivalence, compute sum, validate target against valid_targets allow-list AND GD existence, call goTo() or handleRiddleFail.
  - handleRiddleFail(riddleConfig): increment S.riddle_attempts, show shake animation + attempts counter; on max_attempts exhausted call goTo(fail_target).
  - renderRiddle(sec): replaces renderChoices for paragraphs with sec.riddle field; renders input + submit button + feedback row; optional manual-exit button when fail_target_label is set.
renderGame() modified to dispatch to renderRiddle when sec.riddle present; dead-end check bypassed for riddle paragraphs (their choices array is empty by design).
group_18_letter_sum_riddle.anti_cheat: Answer string never stored in code, data, or localStorage. Only modifier + valid_targets + fail_target + max_attempts stored. Math sum is one-way: 76 has thousands of letter-string preimages, so a player inspecting modifier:916 and valid_targets:[992] cannot recover "кладбище" algorithmically.

canonical_notes.FORCE: FB2 canon: "Прибавит вам силу и увеличит вашу СИЛУ УДАРА в бою." Persistent buff applied to player attack math for whole combat duration. Implementation: combatState.forceBuff=true, pMod += 2 in combatRound. Single cast per combat (re-click prevented).
canonical_notes.WEAKNESS: FB2 canon varies: "Сделает вашего врага неуклюжим и неповоротливым, ослабит СИЛУ его УДАРА" (general) and "уменьшите на 2 СИЛУ УДАРА любого из Гоблинов" (single target in multi-enemy fights). Engine applies -2 globally to all active enemies because per-round attack math doesn't track which single enemy was targeted; slightly more generous than canon for multi-enemy fights but matches the spirit of "ослабляет врага в этом бою".
canonical_notes.COPY: Pre-existing implementation (commit aeebe69) clones the strongest active enemy and runs auto-combat between clone and original. Unchanged by group_19.
canonical_notes.FIRE_combat: NOT IMPLEMENTED in this group. FB2 canon at §436 and §528 explicitly forbids FIRE on trees ("Пользоваться заклятием Огня на дереве неразумно — спалите все дерево"). Where FIRE is allowed in combat narrative, it's pre-combat (cast at a navigation screen that transitions to a different combat paragraph, like §65 → §208). No combat-modal FIRE button needed — pattern doesn't exist in canon.
canonical_notes.HEALING_combat: NOT IMPLEMENTED as combat-modal. HEALING is engine-global HUD #btn-heal restricted to NON-combat moments per spell definition ("В любой момент (но не во время сражения)"). Player can use HEALING between combats to restore stamina.

group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.cluster_description: External 'Topological analysis' PDF + accompanying Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini research reports (uploaded 2026-05-28). The PDF cites symbiont.games as a primary source — the same site that produced the confabulated 'Elgariol/Bardush/Nautilus' visual audit rejected at v2.34. The PDF also relied on a GraphViz file (Подземелья_черного_замка.gv) which is a SIMPLIFIED fan-site map omitting condition-gated edges (luck rolls, inventory checks, spell branches). PDF claims independently verified against actual data: a mix of true, false, and fabricated.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.priority: P3 (no code action — rejection/triage record so future audits don't re-flag from the same source)
verified_claims: §106/§151/§178/§277/§315 'isolated' — TRUE that indeg==0, but the PDF mischaracterised them: these paragraphs DO NOT EXIST in the data at all (sparse-index gaps, not cut content). 46 paragraphs total have indeg==0 from §1's reachable set.
rejected_claims: 'Max index 1366, 145 missing numbers' — FALSE. Data keys are dense 1..1221, no sparse indexing. Fabricated from the gamebook genre's reputation, not this project's data.
'1233 logical nodes, 12 virtual' — FALSE. Data contains exactly 1221. Fabricated.
'BFS depth = 222' — FALSE. Actual BFS depth from §1 is 31. Off by ~7x.
'Longest path = 211 steps' — implausible given the BFS depth of 31; not independently computable (NP-hard on the cyclic graph) but the cited value is contradicted by other metrics.

'§18 hidden transition: parser misses to 23' — FALSE. §18 has both edges correctly in data: →23 (luck_type:'lucky') and →124 (luck failure). The .gv fan map omits one because it doesn't model luck-gated edges; the PDF read that as an engine bug.
'Avg branching 1.72' — actual 1.85 (excluding terminals). Minor numeric drift.
'§86 is cut content (indeg==0)' — FALSE. §86 has indeg==1.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.root_cause: The PDF and its derived research reports analysed the fan-site GV map (a structural simplification that omits inventory/spell/luck-gated edges), NOT this project's actual data. When a luck-roll paragraph in the .gv has only the failure branch, the PDF interpreted the missing lucky-edge as 'parser misses hidden transition' — a category error. Combined with symbiont.games being the primary citation, this is the same confabulation pattern caught at v2.34, just expressed as topology numbers instead of invented characters.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.actionable_findings: None for code. The exercise re-confirmed that 'sources of truth' must be assets/fb2_remake.fb2 + src/remake_data.js, not third-party maps.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.side_note_genuinely_useful: ONE genuinely useful diagnostic surfaced during the verification: 55 paragraphs in the data are unreachable from §1 via choice-edges. This is likely a mix of (a) intentional death-only fail_target endings, (b) post-combat-only destinations reached via post_combat targets not in choices[], and (c) genuinely orphaned content. Worth a focused reachability audit in a separate pass; NOT actioned here.

group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.verdict: Verified NOT a bug. The claimed path is a strict forward chain, not a cycle; no infinite-stamina farm exists.
evidence: The exact claimed path §1128→759→212→104→30→255→15→453 visits every node exactly once — no revisits (forward-only chain).
Self-reachability (true cycle) test: none of §1128/§15/§453/§759/§255/§212 can reach themselves again. Zero cycles among night/rest nodes.
§453's continuation (§376) never loops back into the night path (BFS depth 40, no hit).
§1128 inbound only from §1193; §453 inbound only from §15; §15 inbound only from §255 — single forward approaches, not loop entries.

There are 8 night-rest stamina nodes (§82 +4, §88 +4, §410 +7, §420 +4, §453 +3, §513 +3, §1128 +2, §1181 +4); NONE can return to itself. From §1128 you can later reach §410/§420/§453 but never return to §1128 — distinct nights on a forward journey, not a farm.
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.why_canon_correct: §1128 (one night, +2 stamina) and the later §15→§453 (a different night, +3) are TWO DISTINCT nights on a multi-day forward journey — exactly as the gamebook narrates ('you travel for days and rest each night'). Collecting both rests once each is intended, not an exploit. A once-only night flag would WRONGLY block the second legitimate night's rest and contradict canon.
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.note: 277 nodes lie on SOME cycle in the graph — this is normal for a gamebook (forks you can return to and pick the other branch) and is unrelated to night-rest. It does not create stamina farming because the rest nodes themselves are acyclic.

findings.method: Measured per-spell opportunity surface in current data (engine getSpellId tag+label detection + spell_any + combat allowlists), and cross-checked ILLUSION's canon mentions vs wired hooks.
findings.economy: Opportunity surface — LEVITATION 28 nav + most obstacle crossings; FIRE 21 nav; FORCE 19 nav + 66/76 combats; WEAKNESS 15 nav + 65/76; SWIMMING 11 nav; COPY 5 nav + 65/76; HEALING 1 nav BUT usable anytime out of combat (+8) so effectively unlimited; ILLUSION 4 nav (§41/§350/§779/§1066), 0 combat — the clear outlier.
findings.illusion_finding: ILLUSION sparsity is GENUINE, not a missing-hook artifact. The 5 canon 'иллюзия' paragraphs without a wired ILLUSION choice are all anti-Illusion text, not cast-points: §134 (Fire-branch death — 'no one left to cast Illusion on'), §283 (the 'Illusion fails on the old men' result of the §779 cast), §481 (Woman-Vampire — immune; already combat_spells_allowed:[]), §723 (Spirit — immune; gates to §455, now fixed), §1094 (the Illusion SUCCESS already reached from §41's tagged Illusion choice). So unlike the FIRE coverage gap, there are NO faithful ILLUSION hooks to add.
findings.healing_finding: HEALING is not opportunity-limited — the HUD button casts it any time stamina<max (+8/charge), plus §950 in combat. Broad utility, not a trap.
findings.recommendation: The only 'rebalance' lever is a character-creation hint about relative spell utility. RECOMMEND AGAINST adding explicit usage counts: it is unfaithful (the 1991 book gives no such hint; choosing among 10 picks blind is part of the design) and the canon spell descriptions already signal utility (ILLUSION: 'спастись в тех ситуациях, из которых другого выхода не будет' = situational; FORCE/WEAKNESS = combat). Awaiting Yuriy's call on whether to add any hint or close as faithful-as-is.

findings.principle: Combat spells (Force/Weakness/Copy) work in any fight UNLESS canon explicitly negates them. A mere mention/suggestion is NOT a restriction (the 43 'mention' combats keep the default). A combat spell offered as a NAVIGATION choice (cast -> another paragraph, detectable by a numeric target after the spell name) must be EXCLUDED from the in-combat modal to prevent a double-cast / bypass of canon's special routing. Full-text reading is essential: 'надеясь только на себя ДА НА заклятие Копии' (§1096) and '...Копии, Силы (286) и Слабости (470)' (§536) both PERMIT Copy in-modal despite no-magic-sounding lead-ins.

group_40_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.cluster_description: Betting subsystem, Phase B1 — fair dice + die-gating. The four gambling dice routers (§793, §887, §910, §1187) rendered their six die faces as ordinary choice buttons, so the player simply clicked the winning number — pure cheating that made any payout meaningless. Additionally the two own-die entry branches (§1062→910, §839→793) were ungated, letting a player take the better-odds 'use your own die' path without actually having found a die. This phase replaces the manual face-pick with a real d6 roll and gates the own-die branches on the found-die item «Игральная кость». (Phase B2 — stake deduction + payout application — remains deferred.)

group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.cluster_description: Betting subsystem, Phase B2 — stake tracking + payout application (completes the betting system begun in group_40/B1). Before this, stakes were never deducted (losses were free) and almost no outcome paid out, so the gambling loop had no real consequence. B2 adds a stake state (S.bet_stake), deducts the stake at commit, and applies each outcome's winnings/losses — including stake-relative effects (keep/lose/half/win-N×). Plus the general stake-any-item picker (Yuriy's call: a reusable inventory-select primitive). KEY INSIGHT: the gambling loop is RE-ENTRANT (the player stakes and lands on the same outcome across many rounds), so stake/payout logic CANNOT live in first-visit auto_items — it runs every visit via a new applyBetting() hook. This also fixed a latent bug: §931/§941/§1109 previously paid out only on first visit.

(3) renderStakePicker(sec) — a general stake_picker:true inventory-select widget: lists each bag item with a wager button that records an item stake, removes it, and routes to the item-dice router (stake_roll_target, default §910); the paragraph's non-roll choices render beneath. renderGame dispatch + dead-end guard extended for stake_picker. group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.stake_resolution_interpretation: Documented (tweakable per outcome): lose = forfeit (gold already deducted at commit; item already removed). keep = returned (refund gold / put item back). half = floor(stake/2) gold refunded (gold stakes only). {multiply:N} = winnings of N× the gold stake added (stake itself consumed, not separately refunded). Item stakes only ever hit lose/keep (the half/multiply outcomes are on the gold-die routers).

group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.cluster_description: Multi-slot inventory occupancy. The bag was a flat array where every item counted as exactly one slot (occupancy = S.inventory.length). But two canonical items are explicitly bulky and occupy several slots, which the engine ignored — letting the player carry the diving suit or flying carpet for free alongside a full bag. This introduces an item-size concept so bag capacity is measured by summed footprint, not item count.
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.priority: P2 (inventory-economy fidelity; the suit/carpet are gating items so their bulk matters for resource decisions).
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.canon_basis: FB2 explicit slot text, verified by tight phrasing sweep: §1214 «костюм займет ДВА места в вашем заплечном мешке» → suit=2; §227 «он займет в вашем заплечном мешке целых ТРИ места», reinforced by §193 «освободить для него три места» and §302 «занимает три места» → carpet=3. The same sweep confirmed every OTHER bag item is one slot: §75 banana «займет ОДНО место», §457 «Четыре глаза занимают 1 место», §570/§649 arrows «каждая… одно место». So {suit:2, carpet:3} is the complete multi-slot set; default is 1.
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.mechanism: ENGINE-ONLY (src/game_logic.js), no data change. group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.cluster_description: §887 (Goblin item-stake dice router) face-6 points to §734, which is not a betting outcome at all but a key/door scene. evidence.fb2_887_verbatim: «Вы в надежде смотрите на игральную кость. Что же выпало на кости? Один? — 625. Два? — 769. Три? — 958. Четыре? — 1039. Пять? — 1109. Шесть? — 734.» — the FB2 literally maps face 6 → 734.
evidence.para_734_text: «Достав ключ, вы отпираете дверь. Короткий коридор приводит к следующей двери — 671.» — a key/door scene leading deeper into the dungeon (§671); no gambling context, no bet_payout.
evidence.para_734_real_source: §734's legitimate inbound is §694 (locked Black-Castle-key door): choice «Отпереть дверь Ключом Чёрного замка» gated on inventory «Ключ Чёрного замка». That is §734's true purpose.
evidence.uniqueness: Among all 24 router faces (§793/§910/§887/§1187) this is the ONLY face pointing to a non-betting paragraph. The sibling Goblin router §1187 maps all six faces to real outcomes; §887's other five faces are all real outcomes (625 lose+debt, 769 lose-all, 958 keep+12g+4 apples, 1039 lose+1g, 1109 lose+6 bananas).
evidence.intended_target_unrecoverable: No orphaned bet_payout paragraph exists (every bet_payout is referenced by a router), so the data gives no hint of the intended face-6 target. The 1991 first edition text is not among the project's available sources.
evidence.impact: Rolling a 6 on the Goblin die during an item-stake game teleports the player out of the gambling scene into §734→§671 with nonsensical 'you unlock the door with your key' text; the wagered item is forfeit (removed at stake time) but S.bet_stake is left uncleared. The leak is harmless — S.bet_stake is overwritten at the next set_stake and no bet_payout reads it in between.

options_considered.A_keep_faithful: Leave face-6 → 734 exactly as the FB2 has it. CHOSEN (Yuriy, 2026-06-05). Preserves source fidelity; accepts the broken teleport + harmless stake-state leak on a 1/6 roll.
options_considered.B_remap_769: Remap face-6 → §769 («вы проиграли всё», bet_payout {stake:'lose'}). Keeps the player in the game and resolves the stake as a loss, consistent with §887's other faces; a documented deviation from the FB2 number. (Claude's recommendation if a fix were applied now.)
options_considered.C_remap_625: Remap face-6 → §625 (lose + owe 7 gold); cross-router precedent (§887 face-1 and §1187 face-6 both use §625) but pulls in the heavier debt path.

addendum_2026_06_17_skull_canon_audit.canon_sword_mechanic: Parallel finding (ChatGPT F1). §553 «...подобрать меч (542) или череп (252), или... уйти... ничего не трогая (480)» — the sword is a CHOICE; §542 «Это меч Зеленого рыцаря (возьмите его себе...)» is the take node (reached from §553 ch[0] AND §252 ch[0]). The stone-rats REQUIRE «Целый меч»: §135/§1003 «...Если да, то 166, если нет — 633», and §633 «...меч не в силах разрубить камень. Вам остается только... принять смерть...» = DEATH. Current data: §553 auto_items grants «Целый меч» ON ENTRY, so it is handed to every §553-visitor even if they pick skull or leave (and «Целый меч» gates §135/§1003->166).
addendum_2026_06_17_skull_canon_audit.fairness_analysis: BFS shows all four gas-traps (§842/§854/§859/§913) are reachable WITHOUT passing the skull sources §252/§1116, and §1003 has 10 inbounds, most bypassing §553. So faithful gating would create UNAVOIDABLE item-gated deaths for the many players whose route never offered the skull / sword. The remake has consistently SOFTENED such item-death gates (this group_57 convention for the gas-traps; the §553 sword over-grant for the stone-rats).
addendum_2026_06_17_skull_canon_audit.decision: LEAVE the skull family AS-IS (gas-traps unconditional; §553 sword auto-grant retained). Faithful implementation is canon-accurate but would convert currently-survivable paragraphs into unavoidable deaths inconsistent with the remake's established leniency, and §1116's pickup isn't even wired. group_65_2026_06_17_remake_bug_reports_g.cluster_description: Group A of the 2026-06-17 three-model re-audit (Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini reports verified canon->code->harness). findings.790: P1. ch->678 «Показать Корону (678)» had no inventory_condition, so EVERY player could skip the 6-lion fight (5 lions + ЦАРЬ ЛЬВОВ, then a 6th ЛЕВ). Canon: «Если есть Корона, то 678. Если ее нет, то придется драться со всеми одновременно.» «Корона» is granted @§147 (auto_items) and reachable via §267. Sibling show-item choices (§388 Оберег, §742 серебряный сосуд, §1096 зеркальце) are all gated. FIX: add inventory_condition:'Корона' to ch[0].
findings.1088: P1. ch->96 was tagged spell:'WEAKNESS' — a normal spell cast that spends a charge and navigates, applying NO combat penalty. But §1088 is a WEAKNESS-BACKFIRE node (reached via §96 ch->1088 spell:WEAKNESS), canon: «Коварный рыцарь обратил заклятие на вас: теперь придется во время боя вычитать 2 из своей СИЛЫ УДАРА — 96.» Double defect: (a) the -2 player penalty was never applied; (b) it spent a SECOND WEAKNESS charge (first was spent at §96). FIX: replace spell:'WEAKNESS' with combat_mod:'PLAYER_MINUS2', mirroring the identical sibling §39 (also a weakness-backfire, already correct) and §865 (FORCE-backfire, ENEMY_PLUS2). Engine already implements PLAYER_MINUS2 (startCombat L1777 pModInit=pMod+(pendingBuff==='PLAYER_MINUS2'?-2:0)); the combat_mod branch in makeChoiceBtn precedes getSpellId and calls NO useSpell, so the -2 applies for the whole fight and no charge is spent. (getSpellId would still map the «слаб» label to WEAKNESS, but the combat_mod branch returns before getSpellId is reached — verified.)
findings.944: P2. ch->1081 «Надеть скафандр (1081)» had no inventory_condition; §1081 lets you cross the river / infiltrate under the castle. Canon: «Если у вас есть скафандр, можете надеть его (1081)». «Водолазный костюм» granted @§1214, gated at §16/§182/§391/§430/§951. The other §944 crossings are spell-gated (SWIMMING/LEVITATION). FIX: add inventory_condition:'Водолазный костюм' to the ch->1081.
findings.343: P2. ch->867 «золотой свисток» door had no inventory_condition; §867 opens the locked door. Canon: «Дверь заперта. Есть ли у вас золотой свисток? Если да, то 867...». Parallel sibling §725->142 IS gated. «Золотой свисток» granted @§311 (verified obtainable). FIX: add inventory_condition:'Золотой свисток' to the ch->867.
findings.1090: P2. The three gift choices were inventory-gated but not CONSUMED, so the player kept the (reusable) item after gifting it. Canon destroys/takes each: §857 «Она с презрением ломает перо», §940 «ломает стрелу», §874 «Она берет его и надевает...». FIX: add consume_on_use to ch->857 ('Перо павлина'), ch->874 ('Серебряный браслет'), ch->940 ('Белая стрела'). (Esp. matters for Перо павлина — also used @§972/§672 — and Белая стрела — also a door key @§1196/§871.)
findings.672: P3 (cosmetic). ch->1200 «Есть перо павлина, достаньте его (1200)» had no inventory_condition. Canon: «Если у вас есть перо павлина, достаньте его (1200), если же нет... 819.» Low mechanical impact (§1200 grants NOTHING mechanically and both ch->1200 and ch->819 converge at §819), but a clear fidelity omission — a featherless player should not see the option. «Перо павлина» granted @§98; gated at §972/§1090. FIX: add inventory_condition:'Перо павлина' to ch->1200.

group_66_2026_06_17_remake_bug_reports_g.cluster_description: Group B of the 2026-06-17 three-model re-audit: three obtainability/statefulness chains, each verified canon->code->harness (harness_groupB 21/21). Two were 'narrative-only item' bugs (item described in canon but granted by NO mechanism, with its use-site ungated); one enforces a spell payment. DATA-ONLY, 5 paragraphs.

findings.457_468_pearl: §457 «В ваших руках черная жемчужина — приносящая смерть Зеленым рыцарям» granted the pearl by NO mechanism (all six checked; «жемчуж»=0 grants), while the co-located Crown @§147 IS granted — a clear asymmetry. §468 (two Green Knights) ch->482 «(если есть черная жемчужина — действуйте! — 482)» was ungated, so any player could skip the §46 fight straight to the §482 loot. FIX: §457 add auto_items {items:['Чёрная жемчужина']} (pearl is in-hand on arrival, mirrors the §147 Crown grant); §468 ch->482 add inventory_condition:'Чёрная жемчужина'. NO consume — canon §457 makes it a reusable death-ray («Луч смерти поразит каждого рыцаря»), and §468 fallbacks ch->46/160/39/273/368 stay open for the pearl-less.
findings.662_1196_604_plaque: §662 «Теперь же вы можете снять с шеи Короля бляху с орлом и взять ее с собой» granted the plaque by NO mechanism («орл»=0 grants). §1196 (the five-door antechamber) ch->604 «если есть бляха с золотым орлом, сделайте то же самое (604). Если же нет, то эти двери останутся неприступны» was ungated, so anyone could open the eagle door. §604 «она словно прилипает... взять обратно ее уже не удается» = consumed. PARALLEL gap: the sibling ch->871 (white-arrow door) WAS gated on «Белая стрела» but did not consume it, though §871 «Назад вынуть ее уже не удается». FIX: §662 add auto_items {items:['Бляха с золотым орлом']} (single continuation ch->912, no decline option, so auto-grant on visit); §1196 ch->604 add inventory_condition+consume_on_use 'Бляха с золотым орлом'; §1196 ch->871 add consume_on_use 'Белая стрела'. §604 and §871 each have a SOLE inbound (§1196), so consuming at the §1196 choice == consuming at door entry (semantically: applying the key to THIS door).
findings.76_487_spell_trade: §76 ch->487 «Согласиться и отдать заклятие за перстень (487)» was a plain choice — the ring «Перстень» (a master key, §487 auto_items) was acquired for FREE. Canon §76 «за перстень старичок просит у вас любое заклятие»; §487 «Вычеркните у себя в списке любое заклятие.» FIX: add spell_any:[all 8 spell ids] to §76 ch->487. The engine's spell_any (group_47) enables the choice iff the player holds >=1 listed spell and spends ONE charge (first in list order) on click — enforcing the «любое заклятие» cost. A spell-less player simply can't take this branch (greyed out); §76 ch->1145 (enter castle) and ch->560 (take hide, no ring) remain, so no softlock. Closes the §76 instance of the documented spell-economy residual (group_31/47).

group_66_2026_06_17_remake_bug_reports_g.mechanism: DATA-ONLY, 5 paragraphs in src/remake_data.js: §457 +auto_items; §468 +inventory_condition; §662 +auto_items; §1196 ch->871 +consume_on_use and ch->604 +inventory_condition+consume_on_use; §76 ch->487 +spell_any. No engine change — reuses auto_items, passesInventoryCheck, applyChoiceConsume, and the spell_any branch (all shipped). Item strings 'Чёрная жемчужина' and 'Бляха с золотым орлом' are newly introduced (verified absent from all data before this change) and use the codebase's capitalized item-naming convention; gate/grant/consume all share the exact string.

group_67_2026_06_17_silver_whistle_obtai.cluster_description: Group C, part 1 (the clean half). The silver whistle «Серебряный свисток» was referenced at three paragraphs but granted by NO mechanism — a wiring bug, not a design choice. Canon source found at §303 and confirmed reachable; the use-site has a canonical non-lethal fallback, so gating is safe. Verified canon->code->harness (7/7).
group_67_2026_06_17_silver_whistle_obtai.priority: P2 (obtainability + honest gating; the use-branch was visible to players who could never have the item).
group_67_2026_06_17_silver_whistle_obtai.canon_basis: §303 (Лесовичок fight, reachable via §79): «Победить его не так уж сложно. После этого вы можете взять у него из кармана серебряный свисток...» — post-combat loot. §819 (the mad prisoner): «Если у вас есть серебряный свисток, вы можете показать его несчастному (947), в противном случае вам придется вернуться... 1106.» §947: «...камердинером мага, а серебряный свисток — символ его должности... умоляет вернуть ему свисток.» §1030 (return): «Вы возвращаете свисток камердинеру.»
group_67_2026_06_17_silver_whistle_obtai.mechanism: DATA-ONLY, 3 paragraphs: §303 ch->54 (post_combat) add acquires:'Серебряный свисток' (mirrors the group_15 kill-enemy-take-loot pattern); §819 ch->947 add inventory_condition:'Серебряный свисток' (the ch->1106 fallback stays unconditional, so no dead-end — canon's «в противном случае... 1106»); §947 ch->1030 add consume_on_use:'Серебряный свисток' (returning it to the camerdiner gives it away). §819 is the SOLE whistle gate and §1030 the sole return, so the chain is fully honoured.
group_67_2026_06_17_silver_whistle_obtai.verification: Byte-identical splice — only §303/§819/§947 changed. node --check OK. Regression UNCHANGED 1221/1205/0/76/116 (§303 already post_combat & a combat; the gate conditions runtime visibility, not the static edge; whistle now has a reachable source). harness_whistle.js 7/7 (real passesInventoryCheck: §819->947 hidden w/o whistle, shown w/, fallback §819->1106 always visible; acquires/consume fields asserted; §819 confirmed sole whistle gate).

items.previously_claimed: Gemini graph audit: §1122 narrates loss of a single named item type (knives — «ножей и следа нет»). Engine has no partial-named-loss mechanism — needs lose_substring or explicit lose list.
items.reason: FB2 verification: the «ножей» in §1122 are NOT inventory items. They are wound-effects from a previous trap paragraph. Knife-class items are nowhere granted in any auto_items.items[] across the entire data. The actual §1122 mutation per canon is «вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны, которые были нанесены вам ножами» — a stamina cost, not inventory loss. Applied as auto_items.stamina_sub=5. The lose_substring engine idea is no longer needed for this paragraph.

Gemini 3.1 Pro audit flagged §36 (Trader Skill 7 / Stamina 17) and §760 (Bats Skill 4 / Stamina 6–8) as combat outliers. On review these are intentional pacing choices: the trader is a deliberate HP-sponge / mid-game choke point; the bats are a stamina-drain encounter by design. Neither is a bug. Listing as a design note in case a future balance pass revisits individual encounters, but no engine or data work is required.
items.note_2026_05_24: Verdict unchanged: the trader's Skill 7 / Stamina 17 HP-sponge stays as designed. SEPARATELY, the per-hit damage value (canon: 'не 2, а 4') was missing and was fixed in group_20 subgroup_a (commit 1301c23). The stat block and the per-hit damage are different attributes; this note prevents the damage fix being mistaken for overturning the design-note.

items.reason: Gemini 3.1 Pro audit observed that ILLUSION and HEALING spells have only 1–2 uses each across 1221 paragraphs while FIRE and LEVITATION are mandatory. The audit suggested either rebalancing the canon or warning the player at character creation. Both options are out of scope: rebalancing the canon would mean changing the source book; the character-creation warning is a UX feature that belongs in a separate pass and is not registry-tracked. Diagnostic only — no fix planned. Players read the canon and choose accordingly.
